# status_col / outcome_col = header names the adapter reads BY NAME. date_col = the resolved-date column, or NONE. date_source ∈ {COLUMN, INLINE-FIRST-ISO}: INLINE-FIRST-ISO = the first YYYY-MM-DD in the outcome cell — an EVENT date and a GRADE date are indistinguishable there, so those rows carry the label INLINE-DATE in provenance.
